title: World Peasant Wars
description: HOI4 meets Mount & Blade! Build your state, lead villager armies into battle, and conquer with modern tanks & planes.
body:
World Peasant Wars

**Where Grand Strategy Meets Battlefield Glory.**

Have you ever wondered what happens when the high-stakes diplomacy and industrial warfare of **Hearts of Iron IV** collide with the gritty, boots-on-the-ground leadership of **Mount & Blade**? 

Welcome to **International World Peasant Wars Together Is CREATE**—the definitive Minecraft modpack that transforms your world into a living, breathing theater of war and statecraft. 

### 🎯 Purpose of This Modpack
The primary goal of this modpack is to shift Minecraft from a simple survival game into a complex grand strategy and tactical combat simulator. It is designed for players who want to build nations, manage economies, and command large-scale battles.

---

### 🛡️ Command Your People, Forge Your Empire
In this pack, villagers are no longer just simple traders—they are your greatest asset. 
* **The Villager Army:** Recruit, organize, and lead your villagers into battle. Whether you are defending your borders or expanding your reach, you are the commander of a growing legion.
* **State Management:** Regulate trade, manage logistics, and relocate your population to strategic hubs. Build your nation from the ground up.

### ⚔️ Tactical Warfare & Modern Logistics
Experience a combat system that rewards both strategy and skill. 
* **The Arsenal:** Deploy a massive variety of firearms, explosives, and specialized ammunition.
* **Heavy Armor & Aviation:** Take control of the land and sky with fully functional **tanks, planes, and military vehicles.**
* **Production Lines:** War is won in the factories. Organize industrial chains to **produce, repair, and upgrade** your equipment and vehicles to stay ahead of your enemies.

---

### 📦 Core Mods & Credits
This modpack heavily relies on the amazing work of the Minecraft modding community. All rights and credits belong to the original mod authors. Some of the core mods driving this experience include:
* **Create:** For advanced industrial production and machinery.
* **TacZ (Timeless and Classics Zero):** For the modern, high-quality firearms and combat mechanics.
* *(Please check the **Dependencies** tab for the complete list of all included mods and their respective creators.)*

### 💻 System Requirements & Recommendations
To ensure a smooth experience during large-scale battles and heavy industrial processing, please note the following requirements:
* **Minimum RAM:** 6 GB allocated to Minecraft.
* **Recommended RAM:** 8 GB or more for optimal performance.
* **Multiplayer:** Fully compatible and highly recommended to be played on servers with friends for the ultimate nation-building experience.

---

> **"The era of simple survival is over. The age of nations has begun."**

**Are you ready to lead your state to glory? Download now and join the fight!**
